title: ChatInteractRequest
description: Create a user message and start a run in one call. At least one of content or attachments must be present; services validate this cross-field rule because OpenAPI generator support for anyOf object constraints is weak.

attachments.description: Attachment references submitted with the user message.

level.description: No delta tokens are streamed in any mode; only status/progress/artifact/message/error.

labels.description: Optional labels attached to the run for analytics/ops.

context.description: Optional typed UI/runtime context captured when the user submitted the message. Existing clients may omit it.
